description:
Google Maps MicroG patch bundle for ReVanced GmsCore.

## Supported Google Maps versions

- `26.27.05.941319029` — validated on BYD Dolphin
- `26.26.04.935742811` — legacy compatibility target

## Requirements

- Morphe Manager
- ReVanced GmsCore (`app.revanced.android.gms`)
- A clean APK matching one of the supported versions

Apply the `Google Maps MicroG` patch through Morphe Manager.

This release contains the `.mpp` patch bundle only. It does not include original or patched Google Maps APKs.
